claim: A claimant's burden of proof under Florida's private-sector whistleblower provisions, sections 448.101-105, Florida Statutes, requires only proof of a reasonable, good faith belief of a violation of law, as opposed to proof of an actual violation.
initial_reasoning: The court in 95 So. 3d 106 held that Florida’s private‑sector whistle‑blower statutes (sections 448.101‑105) require proof of an actual violation of law, not merely a reasonable, good‑faith belief. Thus the citation contradicts the claim.
